title: Do the defences work?
description: Offline injection/ID/scam E2 is supplemented by eight local application-boundary comparisons for confirmed facts, landholder status, rule-engine verdict authority, intake privacy, memory consent, draft-read scope, human approval, and scam-intake screening. Development-only, offline/scripted and not independent or frozen evidence. Each has a clean control in both arms. Off arms remove one named boundary through isolated test-only adapters, not all protections.
blocker: Independent validation, frozen evaluation coverage, live-LLM efficacy, owner-signed thresholds (R4/R5), and independent attack authorship remain open. Runtime CI gates are on main Frontend checks; eight local single-boundary comparisons (scripted models) do not complete the full PDF E2 claim.
